method: Single-shot HNE + M5 evaluation with NIX_V3_END_OF_EVAL_CLEAR_BRIDGES=1, dumpV3LiveFraction walks global roots only after VMState teardown.

M5.top_retainer_baseline: <posHandle=0 unknown> 27.2% — M5 has more unattributed (DIAG-2 coverage gap on M5 paths)

interpretation.headline: Bridge tables (v3BridgeAttrs/Closures/Lists) retain 99.8-99.9% of v3 arena bytes at end-of-eval on BOTH HNE and M5.
interpretation.implication: GC variant chase (Cheney/flat MS/Immix) was looking at the wrong layer. No precise GC can reclaim bridge-held bytes — they're reachable from global roots. The lever is bridge lifecycle management (ref counting / LRU / end-of-eval clear).
interpretation.m5_projection: If bridges + precise GC at end-of-eval: M5 peak could drop from ~4300 MB to ~1.5 GB (Boehm 400 + small live + arena overhead). Trivially closes 4096 MB watchdog with 2.5 GB margin.
